claim: .claude/rules is supported from v1.0.89.
limitations: Check attachment, scope and precedence with /instructions for your target path.

claim: Command preToolUse nonzero exits deny; dispatcher timeouts fail open.
limitations: Keep independent CI; a timeout is not a deny.

claim: Selective tools are documented, but noninteractive help requires allow-all-tools.
limitations: If narrow grants fail, use manual approvals or stop; do not widen permissions.

claim: --max-ai-credits is a soft preview limit.
limitations: Set an external budget too.

claim: Agent Plugins 1.0 packages a root plugin.json and skill directories.
limitations: Review package contents and installed CLI options before installation.

claim: The local generator makes a deterministic skill-only ZIP validated against the manifest schema.
limitations: Archive validation does not install a plugin.

claim: The synthetic MCP server implements initialize, ping, tools/list and tools/call.
limitations: Protocol tests do not establish Copilot CLI client compatibility.

claim: HydraFusion Single, Cascade and Critique are research-preview options.
limitations: Check /model for eligibility and /usage for cost; the final answer does not show the internal route.

claim: Copilot login uses OAuth and separate entitlement, not GitLab credentials.
limitations: Requires an entitled account; GitLab credentials are separate.

claim: Token precedence is COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, then GITHUB_TOKEN; classic ghp_ PATs are unsupported.
limitations: Use a supported token with Copilot Requests permission and entitlement.

claim: Copilot supports CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md and GitHub instruction locations.
limitations: Inspect /instructions for actual attachment and conflicts.

claim: Repository-relative @ imports have bounded locations and are not expanded in GEMINI.md or path instructions.
limitations: Use repository-relative imports only in supported instruction files.

claim: Only named shared Claude settings keys have documented Copilot meanings.
limitations: Audit each key; do not copy private credentials.

claim: Subagents need include-custom-instructions true to receive repository instructions.
limitations: Check effective instructions on the selected subagent.

claim: Copilot offers /fleet, /tasks and /rubber-duck.
limitations: Inspect assigned roles and tool permissions before parallel work.

claim: /plan and mode cycling help plan work, but are not OS read-only controls.
limitations: Review plan.md and permissions before implementation.

claim: stayInAutopilot defaults to true after a completed task in captured config help.
limitations: Inspect current mode and /settings after task completion.

claim: Tool visibility, invocation approvals, paths and URL grants are distinct; deny takes precedence.
limitations: Permission filters do not isolate the OS.

claim: --allow-all grants tools, paths and URLs; COPILOT_ALLOW_ALL=true also trusts the working directory.
limitations: Only use in approved disposable isolation; do not set globally.

claim: /model auto routes among eligible models with available profiles.
limitations: Choose among models available to your account and policy; inspect /usage.

claim: Copilot offers continue, resume, fork, worktree, compact and rewind controls.
limitations: Check cwd and current files after resume; rewind does not undo external effects.

claim: --no-remote disables remote control; --no-remote-export disables export and control.
limitations: These flags do not disable model traffic.

claim: --output-format json emits JSONL, not Claude JSON.
limitations: Validate event handling and stdin behavior before automating completion.

claim: The local wrapper checks bounded JSONL framing and returns validation-pending or report-unverified.
limitations: Review the diff and run project checks separately; JSONL framing is not task success.

claim: The local GitLab bridge plans explicit-host GET requests, checks job identity and stores sanitized observations.
limitations: Real reads require reviewed host, IDs and authorization.

claim: glab mr create --fill pushes; explicit source, target and draft flags are available.
limitations: Approve push and MR creation separately; check host and target.

claim: GitLab MCP HTTP access is beta with instance/group enablement.
limitations: Check eligibility and CLI client support before configuring.

claim: /delegate is GitHub cloud delegation, separate from a local GitLab MR.
limitations: Requires a GitHub-hosted target and approval for remote effects.

claim: gh agent-task create/list/view is a GitHub-hosted public preview.
limitations: Check installed gh help and account availability before use.

claim: Agent Plugins schemas/software use Apache 2.0 and specification/docs use CC BY 4.0.
limitations: Recheck attribution requirements if redistributing a changed schema version.

claim: GitHub cloud-agent setup uses .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml with a copilot-setup-steps job on the default branch.
limitations: Requires a GitHub-hosted target and workflow installed on the default branch.

claim: COPILOT_TASK_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS controls -p background wait; default is 600 seconds and 0 means no wait.
limitations: Check support in your installed version before relying on the setting.
